question: storage/cirrus-ci (verdict fails-quota, an artifact-storage view that could not reach the dead API host) describes the same shut-down service as ci-cd-runners/cirrus-ci. Should it be marked duplicate_of ci-cd-runners/cirrus-ci or dead?
why: Cirrus CI shut down effective 1 June 2026 (cirruslabs.org announcement), and cirrus-ci.org does not resolve while cirrus-ci.com and api.cirrus-ci.com fail the TLS handshake; the storage record sits outside this unit's scope.
